prompt: identify top 3 the months with lowest sales by orders, and also by revenue. then calculate the average monthly sales statistics for that year and compare it with these months.
title: Monthly Sales Comparison Analysis
summary: Identify the three months with the lowest sales by order count and by revenue for the specified year. Then calculate the year’s average monthly sales metrics and compare those averages against the low-performing months.
executed_sql_queries: SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)::int AS year FROM retail.orders ORDER BY year;
SELECT store_id, store_name, is_online FROM retail.stores ORDER BY store_id;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month_start,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
    SUM(oi.total_amount) AS revenue
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.order_items oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN retail.stores s
    ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2026
    AND s.is_online = false
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month_start, order_count, revenue
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month_start;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month_start,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
    SUM(oi.total_amount) AS revenue
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.order_items oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN retail.stores s
    ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month_start, order_count, revenue
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month_start;

WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.total_amount), 0) AS revenue
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.order_items oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN retail.stores s
    ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2026
    AND s.is_online = TRUE
)
SELECT order_count, revenue
FROM yearly;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM retail.orders o
JOIN retail.stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.rls_user_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY order_count ASC, month_start ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS month_start,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) AS month_num,
    TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'Month') AS month_name,
    SUM(oi.total_amount) AS revenue
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.order_items oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
   AND o.store_id = oi.store_id
  JOIN retail.stores s
    ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2026
    AND s.is_online = TRUE
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT month_name, month_num, revenue
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY revenue ASC, month_num ASC
LIMIT 3;
